requirements.text: The ATM system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance, preventing overdrafts and ensuring ethical compliance.
The ATM system shall provide a clear process for automatic fund withdrawals from the related savings account when the checking account balance is insufficient.
The ATM system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance for audit purposes.
The ATM system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication, ensuring data integrity and security.
The ATM system shall inform users of insufficient funds before processing withdrawals, enhancing user awareness.
The ATM system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction, enhancing transparency.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds, ensuring user responsiveness and satisfaction.
The ATM system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute, optimizing performance during peak loads.
The ATM system shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history, balancing performance and energy consumption.
The ATM system shall implement load balancing to manage transaction requests effectively, ensuring consistent performance.
The ATM system shall utilize energy-efficient hardware components to operate, minimizing energy consumption.
The ATM system shall automatically shut down during periods of inactivity to save energy, promoting sustainability.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts, reducing waste.
The ATM system shall ensure all transactions are encrypted during transmission, safeguarding user data.
The ATM system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.
The ATM system shall assess the environmental impact of its operations annually and report findings to stakeholders.
